title: Vinyume vya Vivumishi (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the adjective of the opposite meaning, with the same class prefix as the original (mti mrefu -> mti mfupi).
contexts: mental health (afya ya akili): mwenye furaha / mwenye huzuni

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "njia nyembamba" and two more pairs.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___." Kwa nini "mzito" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume ni neno la maana ya upande wa pili, si neno lilelile.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___." Kwa nini "mdogo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha mrefu ni mfupi. Mdogo ni kinyume cha mkubwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___." Kwa nini "kilaini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Vivumishi vingi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino (mjinga, wachache). Vingine hubaki kama vilivyo (laini, moto).

misconceptions.ask: Kuna neno moja lenye maana kinyume?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha kivumishi ni kivumishi kingine: mfupi.
